dataset_metadata.disclaimer: New AI-generated English drafts of the recorded Classical Chinese; not scholarly reviewed. Original source interpretations are not verified geometry or modern etymology.

shuowen:7901.text: Brief or temporary. Formed from 手, with 斬 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7902.text: To break or fold. Formed from 手, with 劦 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to crush.

shuowen:7903.text: To ruin or break. Formed from 手, with 習 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7904.text: To bind or gather. Formed from 手, with 秋 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'The hundred blessings gather here.'

shuowen:7905.text: To pull; to gather. Formed from 手, with 婁 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7906.text: To lose something. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'To drop you would be disgraceful.' Formed from 手, with 云 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7907.text: Holding from the side is called 披. Formed from 手, with 皮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7908.text: Pulling and releasing is called 𤸪. Formed from 手, with abbreviated 瘛 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7909.text: To accumulate. The Odes says: 'Help me raise and gather it.' Also, to pluck at the side of the cheek. Formed from 手, with 此 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7910.text: To sway. Formed from 手, with 卓 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'When the tail is too large, it cannot wag.'

shuowen:7911.text: To move or shake. Formed from 手, with 䍃 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7912.text: To move or shake about. Formed from 手, with 容 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7913.text: To match or oppose. Formed from 手, with 貳 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7914.text: To gather. Formed from 手, with 酋 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7915.text: Firm. Formed from 手, with 臤 indicating the sound. Read like 掔 in the Odes' 'Red shoes, sturdy and fine.'

shuowen:7916.text: To offer up. Formed from 手, with 夆 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7917.text: To lift together from opposite sides. Formed from 手, with 輿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7918.text: To raise aloft. Formed from 手, with 昜 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7919.text: To lift together from opposite sides. Formed from 手, with 與 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7920.text: To lift out. Formed from 手, with 欣 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'They lifted the duke out of the mud.'

shuowen:7921.text: To raise high. Formed from 手, with 曷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7922.text: To lift upward. Formed from 手, with 升 indicating the sound. The Changes says: 'Raise the horse; strong, auspicious.' The quoted wording is uncertain.

shuowen:7923.text: To lift up and rescue. Formed from 手, with 辰 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to rouse.

shuowen:7924.text: To lift a crosswise bar together from opposite sides. Formed from 手, with 工 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7925.text: To grasp. Formed from 手, with 分 indicating the sound. Read like 粉.

shuowen:7926.text: To raise the hand. Formed from 手, with 喬 indicating the sound. Alternatively, 撟 means to act on one's own authority.

shuowen:7927.text: West of the Pass, taking something from above is called 撟捎. Formed from 手, with 肖 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7928.text: To embrace. Formed from 手, with 雝 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7929.text: To dip or stain. Formed from 手, with 需 indicating the sound. The Rites of Zhou says: 'The sixth is the dipping offering.'

shuowen:7930.text: To pull. Formed from 手, with 俞 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7931.text: 搫擭 means not straight or regular. Formed from 手, with 般 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7932.text: The irregular movement expressed by 搫擭. Alternatively, to spread out and seize; alternatively, to grasp. Formed from 手, with 蒦 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7933.text: To clap the hands. Formed from 手, with 弁 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7934.text: To monopolize or act alone. Formed from 手, with 亶 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7935.text: To measure or estimate, glossed by 葵. Formed from 手, with 癸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7936.text: To estimate. Formed from 手, with 疑 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7937.text: To diminish. Formed from 手, with 員 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7938.text: To let go. Formed from 手, with 乙 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7939.text: To loosen and free. Formed from 手, with 兌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7940.text: To put in order. Formed from 手, with 發 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7941.text: To draw out or ladle. Formed from 手, with 邑 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7942.text: To draw out or ladle. Formed from 手, with 予 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7943.text: To draw out or ladle. Formed from 手, with 且 indicating the sound. Read like 樝 in 樝棃.

shuowen:7944.text: To seize from above. Formed from 手, with 矍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7945.text: To draw out from above. Formed from 手, with 卂 indicating the sound. Read like 莘.

shuowen:7946.text: To pick up; speech of Chen and Song. Formed from 手, with 石 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7947.text: To pick up. Formed from 手, with 麇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7948.text: To pick up. Formed from 手, with 合 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7949.text: To pick up and take. Formed from 手, with 叕 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7950.text: To pass through or put on. Formed from 手, with 瞏 indicating the sound. The Spring and Autumn Commentary says: 'Put on armor and take up weapons.'

shuowen:7951.text: To pull tight. Formed from 手, with 恆 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7952.text: To press or kick and pull, perhaps. Formed from 手, with 宿 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7953.text: To pull or assist one another. Formed from 手, with 虔 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7954.text: To pull. Formed from 手, with 爰 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7955.text: To pull. Formed from 手, with 畱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7956.text: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 翟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7957.text: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 犮 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7958.text: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 匽 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7959.text: To push with the hand. Alternatively, to pound. Formed from 手, with 𠷎 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7960.text: To tie or bind. Formed from 手, with 䜌 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7961.text: To pull out. Formed from 手, with 廷 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7962.text: To pluck out and take; southern Chu speech. Formed from 手, with 寒 indicating the sound. The Songs of Chu says: 'In the morning, pluck the magnolia of 批,' apparently; the quotation is obscure.

shuowen:7963.text: To reach far to take something. Formed from 手, with 罙 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7964.text: To reach for. Formed from 手, with 覃 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7965.text: To push. Formed from 手, with 委 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to rub the two hands together.

shuowen:7966.text: To separate. Alternatively, to strike. Formed from 手, with 敝 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7967.text: To shake. Formed from 手, with 咸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7968.text: To press. Formed from 手, with 弱 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7969.text: To pull from one side. Formed from 手, with 奇 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7970.text: To brandish or rouse. Formed from 手, with 軍 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7971.text: To rub or grind. Formed from 手, with 麻 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7972.text: To strike with the back of the hand. Formed from 手, with 𣬉 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7973.text: To disturb. Formed from 手, with 覺 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Only disturbing my heart.'

shuowen:7974.text: To push and pound. Formed from 手, with 茸 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7975.text: To pound swiftly. Formed from 手, with 童 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7976.text: To approach or follow. Formed from 手, with 因 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7977.text: To follow or depend upon. Formed from 手, with 乃 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7978.text: To bind together. Formed from 手, with 𠯑 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7979.text: The action expressed by 抲撝, apparently directing with the hand. Formed from 手, with 可 indicating the sound. The Book of Zhou says: 'Seize them all; 抲.' The final command is uncertain.

shuowen:7980.text: To split apart. Formed from 手, with 辟 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7981.text: To split. Formed from 手, with 爲 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to point with the hand.

shuowen:7982.text: To split. Formed from 手, with 赤 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7983.text: In divination with the Changes, yarrow stalks are placed between the fingers twice before a hexagram is formed. Formed from 手, with 力 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7984.text: Skillful. Formed from 手, with 支 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7985.text: To copy according to a model. Formed from 手, with 莫 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7986.text: Unskillful. Formed from 手, with 出 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7987.text: A sewn finger covering. Alternatively, a sheath. Formed from 手, with 沓 indicating the sound. Read like 眔.

shuowen:7988.text: Round. Formed from 手, with 專 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7989.text: To push it with the hand. Formed from 手, with 圂 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7990.text: To fill a 梩 basket with earth. Alternatively, to disturb. The Odes says: 'They filled it in multitudes.' Formed from 手, with 求 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7991.text: The hands and mouth working together. Formed from 手, with 吉 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'My hands toil and labor.'

shuowen:7992.text: To dig. Formed from 手, with 骨 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7993.text: To dig. Formed from 手, with 屈 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7994.text: To gather in. Being narrower above is called 掩. Formed from 手, with 奄 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7995.text: To wash. Formed from 手, with 旣 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Wash the cauldrons and cooking pots.'

shuowen:7996.text: To take water that is turbid, perhaps. Formed from 手, with 胥 indicating the sound. There is a 揟次 county in 武威.

shuowen:7997.text: To sow. Alternatively, to spread. Formed from 手, with 番 indicating the sound.

shuowen:7998.text: The sound of harvesting grain. Formed from 手, with 至 indicating the sound. The Odes says: 'Harvest it, snip by snip.'

shuowen:7999.text: To stab. Formed from 手, with 致 indicating the sound. Alternatively, to stab so as just to reach it.

shuowen:8000.text: To move. Formed from 手, with 兀 indicating the sound.
